idea-plugin.name: Vibe Agent
idea-plugin.description: Agent harness for VibeIDEA: a native Agent Client Protocol (ACP) client. Connects local coding agents (Claude Code via claude-agent-acp, Codex, Gemini CLI, goose and 60+ others from the ACP registry) to the IDE: streamed sessions, permission-gated tool calls, IDE-mapped file reads/writes. Compatible with the ~/.jetbrains/acp.json agent registry format.
